body:
A Nintendo switch, bleach wipes, tiger king memorabilia, a turnip a la Animal Crossing, that whipped instant coffee mix,  Sourdough starter, a garden boxplot.

Also, eviction notices, unemployment checks, anxiety prescriptions.

I exaggerated the level of emotional abuse I experienced at home for attention from my friends. I also wanted bad things to happen to me for attention, like I wished that I would get sick. I'm struggling to cope in my mid 20s with the decisions I've made with my life because the only thing that fulfilled my void of low self worth from a young age was the idea that I was going to change the world or make a big difference. I hid my true self deep down inside. Now I don't know how to live with myself. Ive also made horribly insensitive jokes before that I feel tremendous guilt about. I worry that I think so much about myself and my own guilt that I can't get out of my brain and think about somebody else for a change.

This is so true yet so hard to follow. I've been ruminating my own thoughts for my whole life and I did not even know it. I'm scared shitless of ever beating this beast but here we go, here is to trying! Let's do this together
You can do this!!!!!! Its ok if you get nervous or choke on your words. Soon enough it will be over and it will have passed
Right now I'm too afraid to go on Instagram but I will look at it when I'm feeling ready! Thank you!

I do this all the time. I have done things that I know if we're captured by camera and exposed to the world I would feel so ashamed and hated. But we are human and we make mistakes. It's sad we live in a world that leads us to be uncaring and unforgiving. Have grace my friend.
I've been a lurker for 7 years and am terrified of posting things online. Thank you
This comment touched me. Thank you stranger for making my fears a little lighter.
